remarks: Discover your own private escape just minutes from the vibrant energy of downtown! Set in a timeless brick building built with craftsmanship you rarely find today, this freshly painted 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment offers the perfect blend of character, comfort, and location.  Step into a generously sized living room ideal for relaxing or entertaining, complemented by an eat-in kitchen ready for your favorite meals. The versatile flex space easily transforms into a dining area or a stylish work-from-home office. The primary bedroom features an ensuite bath for added privacy, while both bedrooms boast exceptional closet space to keep everything organized.  Additional perks include plenty of off-street parking in the rear lot-so you never have to worry about downtown parking-and the peaceful charm of a classic building that feels like home the moment you arrive.  If you're looking for a quiet retreat with all the convenience of city living, this is it. Schedule your tour today!
